messages.subject: For Jeff Miller | Government relations, stakeholder strategy and international energy services
messages.body:
Dear Halliburton Media Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Jeff Miller, Chairman, President and Chief Executive Officer, where appropriate.

Halliburton's international operations depend on trusted government relationships, regulatory execution, local stakeholder confidence and disciplined coordination across technical and commercial teams. Those priorities closely match my current executive mandate.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory across complex resource operations.

I would welcome a senior conversation regarding roles where this combination of external affairs, stakeholder execution and regulated-industry leadership could support Halliburton's international priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Halliburton.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
